value.rationale: A classical natural 2-automatic indicator with infinite palindrome set is assigned a global one-unit optimal factor count range, infinitely sharp endpoints, an explicit decomposition algorithm, exact dyadic subsequence and a nontrivial asymptotic coefficient. This is a new motivated structural invariant of the kind sought in prefix-palindromic-length literature, not a cosmetic rescaling or isolated computation.
